subject: Advice on creating packages that export nimbleFunctions?

messages.author: 9cc042d8ce376c1f
messages.subject: Advice on creating packages that export nimbleFunctions?
parts:
I'm creating some `nimbleFunctions` that I would like to put into a package.

They work just fine when I run them in "not package" form, but fail to compile after I `devtools::install()` them.

I've boiled this down to the following example:

nimbleFunction <- nimble::nimbleFunction
compileNimble <- nimble::compileNimble

```
#' @export
example1 <- nimbleFunction(
  run = function(x = double(0)) { returnType(double(0))
    return(x)  
  }
)

#' @export
example <- nimbleFunction(
  run = function(x = double(0)) { returnType(double(0))
    return(example1(x)*x)
  })
#cExample <- compileNimble(example)
```

When I run the `compileNimble` line, this works just fine.

However, when I `devtools::install()` this (I named my package `nimble.tools`) and then try to `compileNimble(nimble.tools::example)`, I get an error.

I'm pretty confident that this error is related to the call from one function to the other function.

Here is the error:

```
> compileNimble(nimble.tools::example)
Compiling
  [Note] This may take a minute.
  [Note] Use 'showCompilerOutput = TRUE' to see C++ compilation details.
Error: Failed to create the shared library. Run 'printErrors()' to see the compilation errors.
> printErrors()
using C++ compiler: ‘Apple clang version 14.0.0 (clang-1400.0.29.202)’
using SDK: ‘MacOSX13.1.sdk’
P_1_rcFun_nimble_dot_tools8.cpp:38:8: error: use of undeclared identifier 'rcFun_nimble'; did you mean 'rexp_nimble'?
return(rcFun_nimble.tools7(ARG1_x_) * ARG1_x_);
       ^~~~~~~~~~~~
       rexp_nimble
/opt/homebrew/lib/R/4.3/site-library/nimble/include/nimble/dists.h:134:8: note: 'rexp_nimble' declared here
double rexp_nimble(double);
       ^
P_1_rcFun_nimble_dot_tools8.cpp:38:20: error: member reference base type 'double (double)' is not a structure or union
return(rcFun_nimble.tools7(ARG1_x_) * ARG1_x_);
       ~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~
2 errors generated.
make: *** [P_1_rcFun_nimble_dot_tools8.o] Error 1
```

Do y'all have any advice for how to structure my `nimbleFunction`s so that they package nicely?

messages.author: f116cbe5c604c988
messages.subject: Re: Advice on creating packages that export nimbleFunctions?
parts:
Scott, it's great that you're writing your own package containing nimbleFunctions, and I'm certain there's a way to make it work as you're imagining.  That said, from reviewing this information I'm not immediately sure what the issue is.

However, I can point you to the BayesNSGP package, which contains a number of nimbleFunctions which all cooperate with the base nimble package and the nimble compiler.  Maybe you can compare what you're doing with this example, and identify a critical difference?

For other examples of packages providing nimbleFunctions, you can also take a look at nimbleSCR, nimbleHMC, and nimbleSMC.

Beyond this suggestion, we might need to really look at your actual package code to figure out what the issue is.

Cheers,
Daniel

To reproduce:

Anyhow, I'll poke through the packages you've cited.  It looks like they have some stuff for working with sparse matrices as well, which will be helpful!

messages.subject: Re: Advice on creating packages that export nimbleFunctions?
parts:
Scott, I followed your instructions with the following two modifications:

(1) Adding the line:

Depends: nimble         ## added to DESCRIPTION

to the package DESCRIPTION file, after this file was auto-generated by devtools::create().

(2) Inserting a call to devtools::build() into the workflow you outlined, located as:

devtools::document()
devtools::build()       ## added
devtools::install()

After these two changes, both nimbleFunctions successfully compiled for me, after restarting R and loading the example package.

Please let me know if this works for you, as well.

Cheers, keep in touch,
Daniel

messages.subject: Re: Advice on creating packages that export nimbleFunctions?
parts:
I continue to get the same errors.  It looks like something strange is happening with replacing "." with "_dot_" in the ast:
```
error: use of undeclared identifier 'rcFun_devtools'
return(rcFun_devtools.example5(ARG1_x_) * ARG1_x_);
```

I looked at this line, and indeed this function is used elsewhere as:
```
rcFun_devtools_dot_example5(ARG1_x_);
```

I have tried to manually edit this part of the generated c++ code, and to recompile, but I'm having issues getting the control settings just right.

I'm currently using:
```
# generate the code
compileNimble(example, dirName="cCode")
# (edit the code then) compile the already-generated code
compileNimble(example, dirName="cCode", control=list(writeCpp=FALSE))
```

This last line isn't working the way I expected, and compileNimble is still re-generating the c++ code.  Can you give some advice on getting the control settings right so that I can try to debug the issue at the c++ level?

Best,
-Scott

Daniel
